_comment: Rules for social posts, on top of rules/blog-claims.json (copied from Blog-Brain rules/claims.json at 938d82d, 2026-11-04; re-copy when that file changes). Severity: block = cannot publish; fix = change it, or the owner overrides with a logged reason; review = the owner looks closely (amber topic). Patterns are JavaScript regex source, case-insensitive unless 'flags' says otherwise. 'unless' skips a match when the whole post also matches it. Each rule has passing and failing controls in test/check.test.js. Not legal advice: counsel sets the final list. Section numbers and evidence: research_notes/Social media personality for Chapter3/compliance_rules.md.

rules.why: S-5: a number that has not been filled in from a source on file.
rules.fix: Fill it from Chapter3's dataset or a public source, and add the source to the draft's facts list.

rules.why: L-2, SC Code 40-57-135(E)(1): an address or MLS number is advertising of that property. Another firm's property needs written permission and 'listed by [firm]'.
rules.fix: Remove the address. For a Chapter3 listing or one with written permission on file, set listingAuthorization on the draft and add 'listed by [firm]'.

rules.why: L-6, Reg Z 12 CFR 1026.24: a payment amount, down payment, loan term or APR triggers full credit disclosures. Chapter3 is not a lender.
rules.fix: Keep financing qualitative: 'your lender quotes the real numbers'. Rent, HOA fees, taxes and insurance amounts are fine.

rules.why: S-7: a promise about money or prices is misleading advertising (SC 40-57-710; FTC Act s.5).
rules.fix: Say what happened, with the date and the source. Never what will happen.

rules.why: B-3: Chapter3 does no property management (Blog Brain BIZ-5).
rules.fix: Chapter3 helps people buy and sell. Management is a separate company's job.

rules.why: L-5, HOPA 42 USC 3607(b): adults-only or 55+ wording is legal only for a community that qualifies. Otherwise it is familial-status discrimination.
rules.fix: Remove it, or name a community on the verified 55+ list and set verified55 on the draft.

rules.why: L-4, 42 USC 3604(c) and 24 CFR 100.75: words about who a place suits, or who lives there, can be steering. These add to Blog Brain's fair-housing rule.
rules.fix: Describe the property and the place: size, distance, price, rules. Never the people.

rules.why: L-12: REALTOR is NAR's trademark, for members only, and never a generic word for 'agent'. Membership is not yet confirmed.
NAR SoP 12-1 (if a member): 'free' for a brokerage service needs its conditions stated. The free investor tool is not a brokerage service and is fine.
rules.fix: State the condition, or call it what it is: 'we'll run the numbers on your house, no charge, no obligation'.

rules.why: Blog Brain WORD-4, and LinkedIn's 2026 classifier cuts views of generic AI-sounding posts by about 40%.
L-8 and L-9, FTC 16 CFR 465 and 255: a client's words need written consent on file. Invented clients are illegal.
rules.fix: Confirm the consent is on file and the words are exact. Otherwise remove it.

rules.why: SC 40-57-710: a claim of a sale, a closing or a listing must match a documented Chapter3 transaction. Gus is a cartoon and has never sold anything.
rules.fix: Name the documented transaction in the draft's facts, or remove the claim.

rules.why: L-10, NAR Article 15 and SC defamation law: anything said about another firm or agent must be true and provable. Opinion about a national company's product is allowed; a local firm is never the joke.
rules.fix: Check every factual claim about them is true with a source on file. Never mock a local firm.

rules.why: L-11 and website non-negotiable 5: no conclusion about a named building, HOA or builder. Observable, dated facts only.
rules.fix: Keep only dated, sourced facts (fee, assessment amount, date). No adjectives about the building or its board.

rules.why: S-6: a call about the future goes in ledger/predictions.md and is graded in public. A wrong crash call costs a broker credibility with sellers.
patterns: \b(?:prices|rents|values|inventory|sales|the market|home prices|condo prices)\b[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:will|going to|gonna|expected to|about to)\b
rules.fix: Log it in ledger/predictions.md with the date, the number and the date it will be graded.

rules.why: Amber topic: the most viral subject in real estate and the one most likely to anger other agents. State how it works, with the date, never who is right.
rules.fix: Facts only: what the agreement says, who pays, that it is negotiable.

rules.why: Amber topic. Legal, but it can make enemies in town, and SC 16-17-560 limits how Chapter3 can police staff politics.
rules.fix: Say what the vote or rule does to an owner or buyer, with the date. No party, no person.

rules.why: Do-not-joke list: these subjects get literal, useful posts only. The kill switch blocks joke posts during active storm alerts.
rules.fix: No joke on this subject. Keep the useful fact only, or wait.

rules.why: B-5: Tim may be mentioned. He is never the joke.
rules.fix: Check the sentence about Tim is literal and respectful. Use 'Tim Nash' in every visible place.
